_what: The shape CodeBuddy Code itself writes into ~/.codebuddy/projects/<encoded>/<uuid>.jsonl, so the converter can be checked against CodeBuddy instead of against our own assumptions.
_why: Third instance of one failure: the converter produced rows the target reads but does not fully populate. OpenCode crashed on a missing modelID, Claude got a stale model and three absent fields, and here user rows had no providerData and assistant rows no parentId -- so the replies chained to nothing.

_derived_from.note: 'required' are the keys present in every sampled row of that role. Row types the converter does not emit (reasoning, file-history-snapshot, summary) are out of scope.

_refresh: Re-derive against a real ~/.codebuddy/projects after a CodeBuddy upgrade: read the newest session files, key rows by type (and by role for type='message'), intersect the key sets. A stale fixture is visible and fixable; an assumption baked into a test is neither.

observed_values.providerData: on assistant rows carries messageId, and skipRun/error on interrupted turns; on user rows it is present but usually empty
observed_values.model: 'hy3' -- CodeBuddy model ids follow no prefix pattern, so the source engine is the only reliable test for whether a model may be carried over

chain._what: CodeBuddy 从文件末尾顺着 parentId 往回走来重建 transcript，不按行序读。
chain._why: 缺一环，那一环之前的全部记录就丢了：恢复出来的会话看着像新开的。
